mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT prp.FACTORY_CODE, prp.MATERIAL_CODE, prp.MATERIAL_DESC, msc.MES_CAPACITY, msc.STANDARD_CAPACITY, msc.APS_CAPACITY, msc.VULCANIZATION_TIME FROM t_dp_demand_plan prp LEFT JOIN t_mdm_sku_lh_capacity msc ON msc.FACTORY_CODE = prp.FACTORY_CODE AND msc.MATERIAL_DESC = prp.MATERIAL_DESC AND IFNULL(msc.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 WHERE IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT STRUCTURE_NAME, CX_MACHINE_BRAND_CODE, LH_MACHINE_MAX_QTY, MAX_EMBRYO_QTY, FROM t_mdm_structure_lh_ratio WHERE IFNULL(IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND STRUCTURE_NAME IN
#{structureName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT csc.FACTORY_CODE, csc.STRUCTURE_NAME, csc.MIN_VULCANIZING_MACHINE AS MIN_LH_MACHINE_QTY, msc.MIN_VULCANIZING_MACHINE AS MONTH_MIN_LH_MACHINE_QTY FROM t_dp_cycle_struct_config csc LEFT JOIN t_dp_month_cycle_struct_config msc ON msc.FACTORY_CODE = csc.FACTORY_CODE AND msc.STRUCTURE_NAME = csc.STRUCTURE_NAME AND IFNULL(msc.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 WHERE IFNULL(csc.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND csc.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND csc.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND csc.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL}
